perspectives.query: explain how feedback loops shape both ecosystems and human habits
perspectives.insight: Reinforcing feedback loops amplify small initial shifts into lasting momentum, while balancing feedback loops restore equilibrium whenever a system drifts too far from stability.

perspectives.query: what makes an explanation truly illuminating
perspectives.insight: A great explanation does more than list facts—it reveals the underlying generator so you can predict new cases and see why the phenomenon could not easily be otherwise.

perspectives.query: how does play contribute to discovery and intelligence
perspectives.insight: Play creates a low-stakes sandbox where the mind can recombine rules freely, discovering creative strategies that rigid goal-directed search would overlook.

perspectives.query: why do cross-disciplinary thinkers often make breakthroughs
perspectives.insight: Breakthroughs often happen at the borderlands between fields, when a mathematical tool or metaphor from one domain unlocks a long-standing puzzle in another.
